flows.counterexample: Fresh clone contains the committed plan/build but no run snapshots: snapshot loading fails with SNAPSHOT_MISSING and exit 2 rather than starting S2.

trace.observed: S1's final pass includes its independent check. With no active todo, the next work is S2's first todo, so T2 exposes the boundary.
The coordinator evaluates the stop request and branch before launching work, commits only the plan directory, appends no receipt and returns SLICE.
HEAD movement after that commit changes state identity. Resume reports drift and still selects S2's first todo; unchanged receipt history is not replayed.
In the same clone, the next child investigates drift, reruns affected checks and appends a recovery receipt from the old end state to a fresh snapshot.
Recovery makes S2's todo active, suppressing sliceStart. Its later pass clears activity. The last slice proceeds to the one final wave and result review.
A missing baseline or receipt snapshot is an error, not recoverable HEAD drift. The builder must checkpoint instead of continuing in a fresh clone.
